providerIdentity: sda-platform-capability-catalog.v1 capabilities[].provider is the explicitly named provider. It is not capabilities[].capabilityId, a module path, or a profile ID. Group repeated declarations by the exact provider name.
mechanics: The platform capability catalog declares its provided-mechanic vocabulary in providesMechanics[]. Preserve these catalog vocabulary entries as minimal declared definitions with no invented description. Separately load the richer named mechanics[] definitions from semantic-value-mechanics-authority.v1 and platform-effect-mechanics-authority.v1. Preserve their distinct source profiles; never equate similar names such as canonicalization and canonicalize.
implementation: A provider-mechanic implementation is the explicit capabilities[].provider -> capabilities[].providesMechanics[] declaration. Collapse repeated pairs across catalog entries, retaining all contributing observations. This is declared implementation, not a conformance or runtime-readiness assessment.
capability: Catalog capability IDs inhabit the platform namespace. They are dependencies with exact definitions, not additional managed capability memberships or invented Scenarios.
profile: Only graphProviderProfiles[].profileId declares a Provider Profile. A providerModule or profileId does not by itself declare a Provider identity.
generation: Expand the original capture with the exact bootstrap Git revision pinned by its captured package-lock.json. Create a new closure snapshot and remap source appearances/observations/lineage into it; reuse existing entity and content identities. Never observe the mutable checkout as if it were the pinned version.
